summary: Maintains a FIFO table of recent TouchDesigner errors, warnings, and messages with filters for severity, source type, node path, and message text.

key_params.name: active
key_params.note: Allow or inhibit new messages being added to the log

key_params.name: severity
key_params.note: Filter message, warning, abort, or combinations

key_params.name: type
key_params.note: Filter by source operator family or type

key_params.name: source
key_params.note: Filter to specific project paths or nodes

key_params.name: logcurrent
key_params.note: Traverse all nodes and capture current errors

key_params.name: callbacks
key_params.note: Callback script DAT run once for each incoming message

key_params.name: executeloc
key_params.note: Choose where callback scripts execute from

key_params.name: fromop
key_params.note: Operator context used when Execute From is set to Specified Operator

key_params.name: clamp
key_params.note: Limit FIFO output to a bounded number of messages

key_params.name: maxlines
key_params.note: Maximum number of message rows retained when Clamp Output is on

key_params.name: clear
key_params.note: Clear all logged rows except the heading

key_params.name: extension
key_params.note: Edit/view file extension exposed to external editors

key_params.name: customext
key_params.note: Custom editor extension when Extension is set to Custom Extension

key_params.name: wordwrap
key_params.note: Common DAT node-display word wrap setting

common_gotchas: Error DAT is a recent-message FIFO; it is not a permanent project log unless clamping and export are configured.
The default clamp can hide older errors during noisy failures.
Filters use pattern matching, so generated diagnostics should expose severity/source filters rather than hard-coding one view.
Callbacks fire once for each incoming message; scripts should avoid creating additional recursive error spam.
key_concepts: Collects recent TouchDesigner messages and errors in a FIFO DAT table.
Severity, type, source, and message filters narrow which log entries are captured.
Callbacks can run for incoming messages that pass the filters.
Log Current scans the current network state and appends existing operator errors.
